note: Hand-curated industrial pollution sources for the Vaigai basin. Compiled from Madras HC orders (Dec 2024 PIL), DHAN Foundation CURE study, news coverage of toxic-foam incidents, SIDCO estate registers, and the Columbia GSAPP Madurai water-urbanism studio. Coordinates are best-effort approximations of estate / town centers; verify before quoting in print.
source: Madras HC Madurai Bench (Dec 2024 PIL); DHAN Foundation CURE study; TNSIDCO industrial-estate register; Columbia GSAPP Madurai water-urbanism reader; news reports on Vaigai/Sellur toxic-foam incidents

sources.name: SIDCO Industrial Estate, Kappalur
sources.description: Major industrial estate in south Madurai (Tirumangalam Circle, Madurai South taluk). Houses polymer manufacturing, houseware, engineering service units. Pin code 625008. Estate has on-paper effluent treatment + rainwater harvesting; downstream effluent enters the Vaigai catchment.

sources.name: SIDCO Industrial Estate, K. Pudur
sources.description: Inner-Madurai SIDCO estate hosting small-scale manufacturers within ~2 km of the Vaigai. Like Kappalur, official documentation cites ETP + stormwater systems; the actual effluent load on Vaigai is undisclosed.

sources.name: Sellur sewage discharge zone
sources.description: North-bank Vaigai stretch where Nethaji Nagar, SMP Colony, Shantiniketan, Madichiyam, and Sellur dispose solid waste and raw sewage into the river. Toxic foam incidents reported on Sellur pond + adjoining Vaigai stretch (Aug 2022, Nov 2024) following heavy rain - surfactants from upstream effluent + stormwater agitation. CPCB station 10059 (Vaigai U/S Madurai) sits ~1 km upstream of this zone.

sources.name: Dindigul tannery cluster
sources.operator: Multiple private tanneries (consent under TNPCB Red category)
sources.description: Dindigul has hosted a long-standing leather tannery cluster (post-1990s relocation from Vellore-Ranipet under SC orders). Tannery effluent reaches the Vaigai through small streams + irrigation drains in Dindigul district before merging with the mainstem near Athoor / Sholavandan. CPCB and TNPCB have run multiple compliance drives; tanneries here operate on TNPCB Red-category consent with mandated CETP discharge. Salinity + Cr loading are persistent compliance concerns.

sources.name: Theni district textile dyeing units
sources.description: Theni district textile dyeing units came under scrutiny after the Madras HC ordered closures in the Tiruppur cluster (2011 Noyyal verdict) and TNPCB extended compliance drives to neighbouring districts. New units must meet zero-liquid-discharge (ZLD) norms; older units historically discharged to Vaigai-system tributaries (Manjalar, Varaha) feeding the Vaigai dam.

sources.name: Vaigai multi-district discharge inventory (Madras HC 2024)
sources.name_ta: வைகை பல மாவட்ட கழிவுநீர் பட்டியல் (சென்னை உயர் நீதிமன்றம் 2024)
sources.operator: Madras HC Madurai Bench / TNPCB / district administrations
sources.description: In Dec 2024 the Madras HC took suo motu cognisance of dangerous Vaigai pollution. Submissions in court flagged 177 sewage + industrial discharge points across Madurai, Theni, Dindigul, Sivagangai, and Ramanathapuram. Water samples from 36 of those sites were classified below CPCB Class D (unfit for agriculture or industry). Hazardous shrimp-farm waste was specifically called out. The HC ordered an action plan from each district by 20 Jan 2025 - the inventory is the canonical 'who pollutes Vaigai where' list.
